fit_to_spice.description: Make a passive SPICE subcircuit from a Touchstone file (S-parameters of a passive N-port, for example from an EM simulation), with a typed error report. Method: vector fitting with common poles, a Hamiltonian passivity test, residue perturbation when the test fails, and a subcircuit of C, G, F and V elements that ngspice and Xyce both read (pins p1 p1_ref p2 p2_ref ...). Each conductance is a G source controlled by its own voltage (noiseless), because a resistor of the realisation adds noise that has no relation to the passive. With uses.noise_band_hz the subcircuit gets port noise currents with the correlation 4kT Re Y(f0) of the passive (Twiss, f0 the centre of the band), checked in ngspice against 4kT Re Z at each port; without it the subcircuit is noiseless and the fit-band gate of check_requirements fails a noise analysis that uses it. Inputs: touchstone (the file, relative to the design root; version 1 or 2, S-parameters only), uses (required: the frequencies at which the simulation will use the model, {"band_hz": [f_lo, f_hi]} or {"f0_hz": f0, "harmonics": H} for harmonic balance, "dc" (default true: the simulation solves a DC point through the model, as every SPICE analysis does), and "noise_band_hz" (optional [f_lo, f_hi], at most 5 % wide around its centre: the band of the noise analyses that use the model)). The record keeps uses: the fit-band gate of check_requirements fails each ac, sp or noise analysis of a bench that uses the model outside uses.band_hz, dc_policy (optional, "model": accept the DC value of the model when the data has no 0 Hz point; the response reports it), fit_band_hz (optional [f_lo, f_hi]: fit only the data in this band), order (optional, the number of poles; default: the lowest even order from 2 to max_order, default 40, that meets limits.max_abs_ds), limits (optional: max_abs_ds, default 0.01; use_max_abs_ds (default max_abs_ds) and use_max_abs_db, the error against the data in the band of use; l_rel_error and q_rel_error with lq_band_hz), lq_band_hz (optional [f_lo, f_hi], 1-port or 2-port: the error of the series L and Q in this band; a |dS| limit alone can pass a model with a large Q error), name (the subcircuit name; default the file stem), verify (default ["ngspice", "xyce"]: simulate the subcircuit in each simulator with AC runs and compare with the model and, on a uniform data grid, with the data). The run is refused (status failed, every measurement failed, no subcircuit) when uses is missing, when the data band does not cover every frequency in uses (an extrapolation is not supported by the data), when uses.dc is true and the data has no 0 Hz point without dc_policy "model", when the fit does not meet the limits, or when the model is not passive after enforcement. Measurements: order, fit_max_abs_ds, fit_rms_abs_ds, s<i><j>_max_abs_ds and s<i><j>_rms_abs_ds per entry, l_max_rel_error and q_max_rel_error (with lq_band_hz), passivity_margin (1 - the largest singular value of the model, sampled from 0 Hz to 10^4 times the band end and at the poles; the Hamiltonian test has no crossing), enforcement_max_abs_ds (the change of the model at the data points by the enforcement), use_max_abs_ds and use_max_abs_db (the error against the data at the data points in the band of use, after enforcement; dB error where |S| >= 0.1: the acceptance values of a fit, a higher order is not a better fit when they do not fall), noise_f0_hz and noise_verify_max_rel_error (with uses.noise_band_hz), band_min_hz, band_max_hz, verify_<sim>_max_abs_ds (simulated subcircuit against the data) and verify_<sim>_model_max_abs_ds (against the rational model; above 1e-4 is an error). Outputs: work/<name>.lib (role subckt), work/<name>.model.s<N>p (role touchstone: the model at the data frequencies), work/fit.json (role report: poles, errors, passivity, DC values of the model, re-simulation), and the decks and logs of the re-simulation. The kernel adds the Touchstone summary (ports, band, passivity, reciprocity) to the input and to the model file.
